newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks end at 7-yr peak on Wall Street rise.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks end at 7-yr peak on Wall Street rise.

text.p: Taiwan share prices, fuelled by Wall Street's record surge, closed at another seven-year high on Wednesday following the lead of bellwether electronic shares, brokers said.

The weighted index reached a seven-year intra-day high of 9,415.58 points but suffered late profit-taking after hitting resistance at 9,400 and settled for a gain of 57.41 points or 0.62 percent to finish at 9,362.68.
The close surpassed the 9,322.84 finish on Monday and was the index's highest level since it closed at 9,665.50 on April 28, 1990.

The 9,362.68 finish was nearly twice the index's 4,692.40 close on March 12, 1996 that came amid foundering market confidence induced by China's war games near the Taiwan Strait ahead of Taiwan's presidential election on March 23 that year.
Wednesday's turnover was a voluminous T$212.9 billion, but still lower than the all-time high of T$251 billion registered on June 19.
"Originally, Taiwan's stocks were to enter a consolidation after recent gains, but Wall Street's bull run again helped boost the Taiwan index," said Nomura Securities analyst Amy Huang.
